note: Fingerprints of 20 real Pokemon cards' published artwork, each degraded 8 ways to imitate a phone camera (downscale, blur, dim, over-bright, 2.5 degree rotation, low contrast, 3% mis-frame, JPEG q45), hashed through the six candidate crops in OFFSET_BOXES. Matched against 3,000 real fingerprints from card_hashes.json.gz. See cameraMatch.test.ts for what this is checking and why.
